title: Energy Trading & Risk Management
thesis: Snowflake consolidates trade, position, and price data across LNG and crude desks — Snowpipe Streaming ingests 500K price ticks daily, ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION catches limit breaches in real-time, and Tasks trigger automated VaR recalculation on every position change

talking_points: RM 4.7 billion daily trading volume across LNG, Tapis crude, and refined product desks.
Two thousand open positions — net long LNG, neutral crude, short gasoil.
Five limit breaches this week — 3 on the LNG desk during the JKM price spike.
